decisions.rationale: "Wilson disease" in the title is used as a modifier of the noun "gene" (Wilson disease gene), so it is annotated as a Modifier rather than a standalone disease mention.
decisions.guideline_section: 3. Annotate disease mentions that are used as Modifiers for other concepts

decisions.rationale: "Wilson disease" in "patients with Wilson disease (WD)" names one specific, well-defined disease with no further categorization, so it is a Specific Disease.
"WD" is the abbreviation defined as Wilson disease in the same sentence; abbreviation definitions are annotated as separate mentions, and the short form refers to the same specific disease.

"toxic milk" is the name of a mouse mutation/strain (a genetic variant in an organism), not a disease name. Organism-related names are not annotated unless a disease is clearly being discussed through them, and here the disease is referred to separately as WD.

decisions.rationale: "WD" in "a homologue of WD" is a short-form reference to Wilson disease, a specific disease, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease synonymous with the long form.
